entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who acts as bait for Ulamog and then channels all of Zendikar's mana through the leylines in a final blast that destroys the titans.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk planeswalker who clears Eldrazi with the bident, then tries to force Nissa to drop the spell by hurling the Halimar Sea, and leaves after the battle.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage planeswalker who coordinates the plan by telepathy and stops Kiora's sea with a spell.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who weaves Zendikar's leylines into a glyph to bind the titans and pours the world's mana into Chandra.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads half the bait army, blocks a falling landmass, and sides with Chandra to attack.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: A commander among the survivors afterward.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A merfolk roilmage leader among the survivors after the battle.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: A vampire leader among the survivors after the battle.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A merfolk ruin diver among the survivors.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan lured to the valley, bound by the glyph, and destroyed by Chandra's fire.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan lured to the valley, bound by the glyph, and destroyed by Chandra's fire.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Eldrazi drones and spawn that swarm the battlefield and rain from the sky.

entities.name: Zendikari bait army
entities.description: The soldiers from kor, vampires, goblins, elves and others who lure the titans into the valley.

entities.name: Glyph
entities.description: A tripartite glyph of leylines a hundred feet wide, burned into the valley floor, that binds the titans.

entities.name: Leylines
entities.description: Zendikar's lines of mana that bind the titans and carry Chandra's fire.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes from which the titans intrude as a distortion phenomenon.

entities.name: Bident of Thassa
entities.description: Kiora's weapon that commands the seas.

entities.name: Halimar Basin
entities.description: The valley where the titans are lured and destroyed.

entities.name: Halimar Sea
entities.description: The sea that Kiora empties to hurl at Nissa.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The ruined city nearby.

entities.name: Keral Keep
entities.description: The monastery where Chandra was recently abbot.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane nearly broken by the titans.

events.summary: Chandra leads the group that baits Ulamog, while Gideon leads the other bait army toward Kozilek, toward Jace and Nissa waiting in the titans' path.
events.quote: The plan involved being as noticeably, tantalizingly alive as possible

events.summary: Jace and Kiora clear Eldrazi drones from the path of the bait army, with Kiora riding waves and sweeping them into a ravine.
events.quote: a wall of water swung around her like a sea god's punch

events.summary: Kiora realizes the titan Kozilek is a distortion phenomenon from the Blind Eternities, not a god.
events.quote: Not a trickster, but a trick.

events.summary: The two bait armies cross in front of Nissa and Jace, and Jace signals them to disperse.
events.quote: Disperse the army. The titans are in position!

events.summary: Nissa lights with magic and weaves Zendikar's leylines into a tripartite glyph that lashes around the titans.
events.quote: A tripartite glyph a hundred feet wide appeared on the floor of the valley in fierce green fire.

events.summary: The leylines go taut and hold the titans, who shriek and shake the earth, but the spell absorbs all of Zendikar's mana.
events.quote: But then the leylines snapped taut.

events.summary: The titans distort, the sky becomes the titans, and it begins raining Eldrazi.
events.quote: And then it began raining Eldrazi.

events.summary: Cracks spread through the titans as the glyph erodes them, but Zendikar breaks faster and floating landmasses begin to fall.
events.quote: The titans, finally, were beginning to break.

events.summary: Chandra wants to burn the titans but Jace forbids it, since damage would collapse the glyph.
events.quote: Any damage to the titans or to Nissa will snap the leylines and collapse the glyph spell.

events.summary: Kiora argues that Zendikar will die with the titans and demands Nissa let them go; Jace insists they must be destroyed here.
events.quote: Zendikar will perish if they do.

events.summary: Gideon sides with Chandra, and Jace asks Chandra if she is certain she can destroy the titans with one spell.
Kiora empties the Halimar Sea and hurls it at Nissa, but Jace splits it into mist.
events.quote: But the sea split in two, and each half split in two

events.summary: Chandra's spell fails to be enough as Gideon blocks a falling landmass with his own body.
events.quote: Gideon leaping from the outcropping, blocking the landmass with his own body

events.summary: Nissa touches Chandra's shoulder, sending the mana of all Zendikar through her, and Chandra ignites the leylines.
The titans are destroyed in a blinding blast, and Chandra collapses.
events.quote: The world flashed with a roar of apocalyptic orange, then went blinding white.

events.summary: Survivors gather in the ash with no celebration, and Kiora leaves with the bident.
events.quote: And she didn't stop walking for a long time.

relations.note: Nissa trusts Chandra and passes Zendikar's mana to her.
relations.quote: in that bond of trust, Chandra knew it too.

relations.note: Kiora hurls the sea at Nissa to force her to drop the spell.
relations.quote: she hurled the entire sea at Nissa.

relations.note: Jace and Nissa work together on the spell.
relations.quote: working with Jace to prepare the spell that would save the world.

relations.note: Chandra's fire along the leylines destroys the titans.
relations.quote: Flames spiraled from Chandra into the streams of mana and branched out across the sky

relations.note: Chandra's fire along the leylines destroys the titans.
Kiora opposes Jace's insistence on destroying the titans.
relations.quote: The poor mind mage didn't see it.
